'''Aurek Base''' was the command center for all [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Military/Legends|Military]] operations on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]].
